**F02 PASS** (high), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:81, Actual native build callers and retirement. Round 6: PASS. Historical revision 4: PASS. D2 removes these executable paths and requires both-host build logs without any shim invocation. The new targets and generator do not exist today. Rationale: The proposed edits address the actual MSBuild caller; the plan does not pretend there is an existing BuildViceNative Nuke target.
